Emplaced Defense. A folding turret for flat ground (not walls or ceilings): 2 Actions to set up or pack (−2 MOVE carrying it; it's off while packed). LL/IR/UV camera. Its mount takes any ranged weapon like a Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount; a DV15 BODY Check rips the gun out, wrecking the mount. Fires until the target's dead, gone or shows a pass.

Cost: 1,000eb
HP: 30
CN: 14
Counter: DV17 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods
